CW.name: Check of weight of coin
CW.description: Checks if a weight of a coin is in accepted interval

CF.name: Check of form of coin
CF.description: Checks if a form of coin is accepted

A.name: Aceceptance of coin
A.description: Accept a real coin and save it in internal tresor

CR.cc$.name: Coin candidate
CR.cc$.description: Some artifact is putted in coin slot. This signal contains data with this artifact

CC.p$.name: Coin is ok
CC.p$.description: Coin checker send this signal, when coin is checked and can be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this coin

CC.r$.name: Coin is not ok (rejected)
CC.r$.description: Coin checker send this signal, when coin is checked and can't be used as payment element. This signal contains data with this coin

CA.c$.name: Change is needed
CA.c$.description: Coin Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted coin requires change. Data contains the change value.

CA.n.name: Change is not needed
CA.n.description: Coin Acceptor sends this signal when the accepted coin requires no change.

CC.cw$.name: Check coin weight
CC.cw$.description: Command to Coin Checker to validate the weight of the coin candidate. Data contains the coin artifact.

CC.cf$.name: Check coin form
CC.cf$.description: Command to Coin Checker to validate the form/shape of the coin candidate. Data contains the coin artifact.

CA.a$.name: Accept coin
CA.a$.description: Command to Coin Acceptor to accept the validated coin. Data contains the coin artifact.
